name: MOURS
desc:
MOURS is a modification of the ROBLOX game "HOURS" that the developers of this game (MOURS) mess around with on their free time whether it'd be real or joke content. We always list our changes within the in-game change logs. (viewable by pressing "Play" on join and not clicking anything)
Developers of this game do not get paid (+ we don't want to) and funds go to the owner of HOURS.

Expect this game to be touched/updated at random, year-long hiatuses may be in motion.
Game updates can be told by either title change or simply looking at when this game was updated on this page.

Play HOURS (Original Game): https://www.roblox.com/games/5732973455
